book.name: DIYON
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Diyon wana Leleli

content: Yudasa alonau Tolohaveyan Hi Nok Yeisu kaiwena

Yeisu i awanun haba Tamana elana, yaka alonau wana tohago hi egon hi na sinawel Kidilon hi kalapanet-an ge hi na hi ha labena etega. He ebwakil olibe ana gungun etega iyoho labi o elana, inoke alonau wana tohago hi na hi tuk gamwanaa.
Yudasa toto Yeisu i wasaan labena o i atena bubun, kaiwena sauga i gewi Yeisu alonau ge wana tohago hi nana hi mimigogo labi o elana.

Inoke Yudasa alonau tolohaveyan ali boda etega, avaliyau ge Limi Bwabwalena ana pulisimanau enuna, bolo topowon bwabwatal ge Palisi hi patunal, hi nok hi na gungun o elana. He elikaya, odam ge elohaveyan hi noahel.
Yeisu iyaka i atena te hauna nasi ni gan elana, yaka i pulinok elal ge i ba, “Henala ge ku loyaan?”
Anana hi lahe hi ba, “Yeisu gagama Nasaleta.” Yaka Yeisu i ba, “Nau te.” (He Yudasa toto Yeisu i wasaan iyoho to alonau i taltalmilil.)
Sauga Yeisu i ba, “Nau te,” inoke hi talsikal ge hi sogu bilibiliya.
Yeisu i nelil al i ba, “Henala ge ku loyaan?” Yaka hi ba, “Yeisu gagama Nasaleta.”
Inoke analiya i lahe i ba, “He iyaka ya ba haba eliyamiu, nau te. Ebo ku loyaagau, inoke alowau bolo ya nuku piluwagil ge nihi egon.”
I ba ola o, inoke wana baaba i tabwa tunahot, toto i ba, “Nam, bolo u pem elau nige etega ya papayaomal.”
Saimon Pita wana elohaveyan kilepana i gan, inoke i kukuyagin abanaa ge topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa wana totuwalali tanana toto labena awonaa i goyoho. Tau o alana Malkas.
Yaka Yeisu i baek Pita elana i ba, “Wam elohaveyan kilepana u teli pasikal abanaa. U nuwatu lomwan ana kom toto Nam i pem bahi na iim?”
Yeisu Hi Pwatanik Anasa elana
Tolohaveyan ali boda avaliya wali tologugui, avaliyau ge Yudiya wali pulisimanau, Yeisu hi lib. Inoke hi yowan
ge houwan hi pwatanik Anasa elana. Anasa iya Kaiyapa yawana, Kaiyapa lagona tamana. Kaiyapa iya topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa baliman o elana.
He Kaiyapa te i baek Yudiya wali tologugui elal i ba, “I waisi te gamagal maisena ni yaomal gamagalau kaiweliya.”
Pita Wana Alaha Houwan
Saimon Pita alona ge tohago etega al
Yeisu hi noulil. Tohago toto o iya ana aatena i gan topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa elana. Inoke iya alona Yeisu hi na hi tuk topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa wana bakubakuwa,
yaa Pita i notalmilila bakubaku ana nog elana. Yaka tohago toto ana aatena i gan topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa elana, i sikal i na i ba yova toto nog ana tomatahikan elana ge abwe Pita i en tukan.
Inoke yova toto nog ana tomatahikan i baek Pita elana i ba, “Age owa al tau o wana tohago etega?” Yaka Pita i ba, “Nigeya, nau nige i oola.”
Panuwa i tultul, yaka totuwalali ge pulisimanau ginaha hi ton ge hi milipainan hi loloamwaligu. Inoke Pita i nok i na alonau hi talmilil ge hi amwaligu.
Topowon Bwabwatal wali Tohouwa Yeisu I Neli
Topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa Yeisu i neli wana tohago kaiweliya ge wana panpankiti al kaiwena.

Yaka Yeisu i ba, “Sauga gegewena ya baaba mwananala gamagalau elal. Ya panpankitiya limi tapwalolo ona elal ge Limi Bwabwalena elana, heliya Yudiya gegewel wali abamimigogo. Nige baaba etega ya babaa sume.
Inoke hauna kaiwena ge u nelau? Bolo no baaba hi hago nu nelil. Heliya no baaba gegewena hi atena.”
Sauga Yeisu i ba ola o, yaka pulisiman etega toto i talmilila gegelinaa, Yeisu gegenana i taganepal ge i ba, “Hauna kaiwena ge u ba lahi topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa elana i ola o?”
Yaka Yeisu i ba, “Ebo baaba etega ya ba panak, nu baunan gamagalau gegewel nihi hago. Yaa ebo ya ba bubun, he hauna kaiwena ge u taganepalau?”
(He ewasi Anasa Yeisu alona ge ana eyowan iyaka i patuna i nem Kaiyapa elana, iya topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa.)
Pita wana Alaha Paeluwana ge Paetonina
Saimon Pita iyoho i taltalmilil ge i amwaamwaligu, inoke gamagal etega i baek elana i ba, “Age owa al tau o wana tohago etega?” Yaka i alaha i ba, “Nigeya, nau nige i oola.”
Topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa wana totuwalali etega, iya tau toto tanana Pita i gogoyoho tutuna, i baek Pita elana i ba, “Owa heiya ya kitewa alom Yeisu olibe ana gungun gamwanaa, age?”
Yaka Pita i alaha al, ge sauga o elana kamkam melutauina i kahin.
Yeisu I Talmilil Pilato Matanaa

Yudiya Yeisu hi ahe Kaiyapa wana limiya, ge hi en pwatanik Loma wali gavana Pilato wana limiya. Sauga o iyaka mweluluga lan i gangan. Nige hi tutuk gavana wana limiya, kaiwena ebo ni pabikel ge nige bosowailiya Nopalegi Hagalena enona nihi an.
Yaka Pilato i na i tagil Yudiya elal ge i nelil i ba, “Tau ya hauna gegi i ginol ge kaiwena ku wole?”
Anana hi lahe hi ba, “Binimala nige gegi etega ni giginol, he nige naha een pwatanim elam.”

Pilato i ba, “He ku ahe ku na ku pakot totomiu wami logugui elana.” Yaka Yudiya hi ba, “Yaa komiu Loma wami logugui nige i tatalam te tage ama Yudiya gamagal etega ana logugui naha ginol ge naha ba ni aliga.”
He i masal i ola to, inoke Yeisu wana baaba ni tabwa tunahot, toto valila i baunan ge i pamasal hauna kaba yaomal elana ni yaomala.
Pilato i sikal i na limi gamwanaa, yaka Yeisu i yogaan ge i neli i ba, “Owa Yudiya wali kin?”
Yeisu i baek elana i ba, “Baaba toto u baunan totom wam nuwatu, o age gamagalau enuna wasau hi baunaniwa?”
Pilato Yeisu anana i lahe i ba, “Age u nuwatu nau Yudiya gamagalina, ine? Wam panuwa gamagaliliyau avaliyau ge wali topowon bwabwatal te hi ahewa ge hi telewa nimwawa. Hauna u ginol panak?”

Yeisu i ba, “No abalogugui nige i miminaa panayawi ya elana. Binimala ebo ni ola, he awau toabinau nihi lut nihi lohaveyan kaiweu, ge bahi Yudiya nihi yoyowanau. Yaa nigeya, no abalogugui nige i miminaa labena ya elana.”

Pilato i ba, “Oo, he age owa kin!” Anana Yeisu i lahe i ba, “He totom te u ba, ‘Owa kin.’ Nuwatu toto kaiwena ge nain i abau ya nem panayawiya i ola hiwe: baaba tutunahotina na wasaan gamagalau elal. Gamagalau gegewel bolo hi minek baaba tutunahotina elana anau hi hago.”
Inoke Pilato i nel i ba, “He baaba tutunahotina hauna kaba bugul?” Yaka i na i tagil al Yudiya elal ge i ba, “Nige ana woliwoli puna etega ya pwapwawa ge tage ana lahi na baunan.
He ku atena te baliman maisena ge maisena, Nopalegi Hagalena ana sauga elana, toulutuk dela etega na sokal kaiwemiu ge ni tagil. Tab nuwamiu komiu Yudiya wami kin na sokal kaiwemiu?”
Anana hi lahe hi yoga hi ba, “Nigeya, iya nige i oola! Ama nuwama Balabas!” Yaa Balabas iya totaulol ge tokaoma.

footnotes.text: Tabam Diyon toto buki ya ana toleleli totona bana te i ba, “Tohago etega al.”
He Diyon 12:32 ge 33 nu kite. Binimala Yudiya wali logugui eliyana ge ni yaomala, he nihi loipati. Yaa Loma wali kamwasa te gamagalau bolo hi lalahel nihi lokolosagil.
